title: My data: a weather file of your own
intro: A weather file may be a Daisy weather file (.dwf) or a table (CSV, TXT) with a date column and the columns rain and temperature. The radiation unit is chosen or found out from the values.

marks.d: The choice that shows the file chooser.
MJ per square metre and day, kWh per square metre and day, or W per square metre; leave on find out when unsure.
